# Bundled browser dependencies

- Three.js 0.160.0: `three.module.min.js`, from https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.min.js. MIT; see THREE-LICENSE.txt.
- Supabase JS 2.119.0: `supabase.min.js`, downloaded from the previously used jsDelivr @2 URL and pinned here. MIT; see SUPABASE-LICENSE.txt.

These files are hosted with the game and included in its offline cache. Update the corresponding license when replacing a dependency.
